chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Ahmad al-Mu'addab (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Abi 'Abdillah al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Isma'il al-Barmaki narrated to us. He said: 'Abdullah ibn Ahmad ibn Dahir narrated to us. He said: al-Fadl ibn Isma'il al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: 'Ali ibn Salim narrated to us from his father. He said:

I asked al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) and said to him: O son of the Messenger of God, what do you say regarding the Quran? So he said: It is the word of God, the saying of God, the Book of God, the inspiration of God and His revelation.
And it is the Glorious Book to which falsehood cannot come from before it or from behind it — a revelation from the Wise, the Praiseworthy. [Quran 41:42]

key_terms.الْكِتَابُ الْعَزِيزُ: The Glorious Book — a Quranic self-designation from Surah Fussilat
key_terms.تَنْزِيلٌ مِنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍ: A revelation from the Wise, the Praiseworthy — Quranic phrase (41:42) affirming divine authorship
key_terms.كَلَامُ اللَّهِ: The word/speech of God — a key creedal designation asserting the divine origin of the Quran

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the nature of the Quran?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Amali of Sheikh al-Saduq, a questioner directly asks Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) about the nature of the Quran. The Imam responds with five ascending attributes — word, saying, book, inspiration, and revelation — and then quotes Quran 41:42 affirming its absolute inviolability from falsehood. This creedal declaration was particularly significant in the theological debates of the third and fourth Islamic centuries concerning the nature and created or uncreated status of the Quran.
word_analysis: may God have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ibrahim b. Ahmad al-Mu’addab (rh) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Isma`il al-Barmaki narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Ahmad b. Dahir narrated to us. He said: Al-Fadl b. Isma`il al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Salim narrated to us from his father. He said:

I asked al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) and said to him: O son of the Messenger of Allah! What do you say regarding the Quran? So, he said: It is the word of Allah, the saying of Allah, the Book of Allah, the inspiration of Allah and His revelation.
It is the Glorious Book, and falsehood cannot come to it from before it or from behind it; a revelation from the Wise, the Praiseworthy.
